function.name: sol_h3
function.description: Generate a video with synchronized audio from text and an optional first-frame image using Sol-H3.

prompt.description: Describe the video and audio while preserving the user's intent (1-8000 characters). Context-IR uses integrated_multimodal_description for visuals over time, overall_soundscape for sounds, and non_diegetic_music for music; use this structure when helpful.

duration.description: Duration in seconds, rounded up to a supported frame count at 24 fps. Supports 124–345 frames (5.167–14.375 seconds); 5, 8, and 10 are valid. For an exact length use frames / 24, e.g. 10.125 for 243 frames. Defaults to 10.

image.description: Optional first frame: an existing PNG/JPEG/WebP file path readable by the generation worker, or a supplied data:image/...;base64,... or base64:// URI. Use the provided image; do not invent an image path or base64 data. Maximum 20 MiB, sides 32–8192 pixels, at most 40 million pixels. First-frame conditioning with the FastH3 adapter is experimental.

aspect_ratio.description: Output shape. Defaults to the first frame's own shape when image is supplied, otherwise 16:9. auto uses the EXIF-upright image ratio (between 1:4 and 4:1). An explicit ratio stretches the first frame. The service uses a 768-pixel short edge, a 1344×768 area cap, and dimensions rounded to multiples of 32.

seed.description: Random seed for reproducible generation. Defaults to 42.
